enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Maiming: This weapon has a twisted haft or grip and spikes along its blade, head, or point. Whenever you score a critical hit with this weapon it deals an amount of extra untyped damage depending on its critical multiplier: x2 - 1 to 6, x3 - 2 to 12, x4 - 3 to 18.
Armor-Piercing 15%: Passive: +15% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)

Insightful Sneak Attack Bonus +2 : Provides a +2 Insightful modifier to your attack bonus and a +3 Insightful bonus to damage for any attack that would qualify as a Sneak Attack, even if the wielder is not a Rogue.
Improved Vorpal: Passive: +0.5[W] damage dice.On Vorpal Hit: If your target has fewer than 1500 Hit Points, they are instantly slain. If your target has above 1500 Hit Points, they take 150 damage.
Slice 'n Dice Set: While wearing both items from the Slice 'n Dice Set, you gain:+1 Quality bonus to Seeker+1 Quality bonus to Sneak AttackThey make julienne fries.
The Devil's Handiwork: While wearing any five items from the The Devil's Handiwork, you gain: +2 Quality bonus to all Ability stats
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
